title: Challenge
description: A generic skill challenge: one or a handful of DC'd checks with no persistent point pool/tracking (see subsystem.schema.json for that — Victory Points, Chases, Infiltration, etc.). Fits the campaign's own Ground Role checks (e.g. a Sensor Operator's Recall Knowledge check during a Contact), Anchor Time scenes, or any one-off skill gauntlet. Structured with explicit DCs and skills so a future probability calculator can estimate the party's odds per check (see reference/tables/dc-and-check-math.json for the underlying degree-of-success math).

description.description: Narrative framing — what this challenge represents in-fiction.

levelContext.description: The level this challenge's DCs are pitched at (usually the Frame's tier for anything tied to a Contact, or the kids' level for a purely ground-level scene) — see design bible's ground-role DC rule: DCs come from the task, never from an enemy's level.

resolutionMode.description: How the individual checks combine into an overall outcome. cumulative-count = GM tallies successes/failures narratively without a formal point pool.

successThreshold.description: For cumulative-count: how many checks need to succeed.

outcomes.description: Overall challenge outcome text, if resolutionMode isn't per-check.

participants.description: id refs of kids/Frames who can attempt this, or a free-text role name (e.g. "Sensor Operator").

relatedRefs.description: e.g. an episode/scene id this challenge belongs to, or a ground-role id.
